body: Advisory Commission on Aging - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2026
  1545 WEST 31ST STREET
  SILVERADO PARK, AFTERSCHOOL CENTER, 10:00 AM

Judi Clarke, Chair  Clarice Kavanaugh, Commissioner
Sylvia Salcedo, Vice Chair  Justin Potier, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Catherine Francis, Commissioner  Harold Sutherland, Commissioner
Carolyn Hines, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Irene.Rodriguez@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56421  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, September 9, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56436  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Adult Education from Long
  Beach City College.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56422  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent’s Update on department
  business.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56437  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the City’s Housing Element
  Implementation Update from Community Development Department.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56450  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the transmittal of
  the City of Long Beach Advisory Commission on Aging 2026 Visibility Plan from
  the 2026 Visibility Plan Ad Hoc Committee to City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2

6.  26-56448  Recommendation to review, discuss, and if appropriate, approve the transmittal of
  a letter from the Fares for Seniors on LB Transit Ad Hoc Committee to City Council
  outlining free Long Beach transit fare for all ages over 50.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56423  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Advisory Commission on Aging on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Irene Rodriguez at (562) 570-3538 or
Irene.Rodriguez@longbeach.gov.
